items.title: Github Migrates Copilot Runtime to Rust with AI-Assisted Rewrite
items.blurb: GitHub migrated more than 800,000 lines of Copilot runtime code from TypeScript and Node.js to Rust in about 14.5 weeks using AI-assisted development.

items.title: The Missing Piece in Rust Error Handling
items.blurb: Rust already has most of what I want from error handling: explicit control flow, errors as values, and concise propagation with ?. The friction comes when deciding what to put in the error half of Result.
